live1hit.text: Live-verified: the parse ledger counts a live hit of the <ITEM> log shape.

live1accepted.text: Live-verified: the parse ledger counts a live hit of the trade accepted / cancelled log shape.

logshape.text: New masked log shapes passed the two-sighting rule: work each NEW SHAPE line of ops/runtime/watch/live1_report.json (copied into the lane worktree) into a parser pattern with a fixture, or note why it stays unparsed. ACCEPT: every listed shape has a fixture and a passing test or a one-line note. SOURCE: watch ledger log-shape, filed <YYYY-MM-DD>.

snapprobe.text: The <FILE> game-data snapshot failed its shape probe (ops/runtime/snapshot/probe.json): compare the upstream shape with the probe table and its reader, then fix the reader or the probe. ACCEPT: a fixture of the new shape probes as pass and its reader test passes. SOURCE: watch ledger snap-probe, filed <YYYY-MM-DD>.
